raw_segments.text: No, thank ye, Bunger," said the English captain.
"'He's welcome to the arm he has since I can't help it and didn't know him then,
No more white whales for me, I've lowered for him once and that has satisfied me.
There would be great glory in killing him, I know that, and there is a shipload of precious
sperm in him, but hark ye, he's best let alone, don't you think so, captain?"
